A command may execute several cases in the package. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Validation limits Only a linear, periodic, smooth single mode is verified. Nonlinear Fisher fronts, complex boundaries, spatial ecosystems and general reaction networks remain outside scope.
